basic_info.description: A grand entry lobby and beautiful skylight welcome you to 949 Fell Street! This boutique 1909 Alamo Square building is now fully updated and ready for the new century! Unit 12 is a top-floor, big-view flat offering three bedrooms, each with an ensuite bath. The open-plan great room includes living room, dining room, and a remodeled kitchen with ample cabinetry, Bosch stainless steel appliance package, a newly installed washer/dryer, plus an island for counter seating and dining. Located at the peaceful rear of the building, huge views include the building's fully landscaped garden patio, city lights, and the southern hills beyond. Freshly painted with new hardwood floors, this home is move-in ready. Enjoy the nearby amenities of Alamo Square Park and the excitement of the Divisadero Corridor, Haight St, and Hayes Valley with their notable shopping, restaurants, and entertainment!
